title: Chat Frontend Implementation

productionFiles.purpose: SSE streaming hook with fetch + ReadableStream
Collapsible card for tool use display

keyFeatures: Tool use cards in assistant messages

testCategories: SSE parsing (8 tests: data: prefix, [DONE], malformed JSON, empty events)
Message state (12 tests: add user, add assistant, accumulate response, clear)
Streaming lifecycle (10 tests: message_start → content_block_delta → message_stop)
Error handling (8 tests: HTTP 500, network failure, abort, timeout)
Retry logic (4 tests: retry last message, retry after error)
Buffer management (3 tests: partial events, multi-event chunks)
Rendering (6 tests: tool name, ID, icon, expand button)
Expand/collapse (8 tests: default collapsed, toggle, animation)
JSON formatting (6 tests: pretty-print, syntax highlighting, copy-paste)
Dark mode (4 tests: theme classes, icon colors)
Multi-tool list (4 tests: render multiple, empty list, unique keys)
Message rendering (10 tests: user bubble, assistant bubble, markdown, tool use cards)
Auto-scroll (6 tests: scroll on new message, scroll on streaming update)
Streaming UI (8 tests: typing indicator, current response, tool use display)
Error display (4 tests: error banner, retry button, error clearing)
Empty state (4 tests: no messages, clear all)
Input interaction (4 tests: submit, disabled while streaming)

e2eScenarios: User sends message → receives response (2 tests)
SSE streaming → typing indicator → complete (3 tests)
Tool use display → expand card → verify JSON (3 tests)
Clear messages → verify empty state (1 test)
Dark mode → theme toggle → verify colors (1 test)

channels: Tool use cards display channel metadata if available
